command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; PREV=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'); printf '%s
' "=== pre voice ===" "$PREV"; printf '%s
' "$PREV" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; echo silent_voice_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 || true; VOICE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'); DTMF=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_DTMF/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_DTMF/p'); printf '%s
' "=== active voice ===" "$VOICE" "=== active dtmf ===" "$DTMF"; echo active_voice_muted=$(printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Muted: true' && echo true || echo false); echo active_dtmf_muted=$(printf '%s
' "$DTMF" | grep -q 'Muted: true' && echo true || echo false); echo audio_mode_line=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -m1 -E 'mode:|Mode:' || true); python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; POST=$(state); echo post_call_state=$POST; test "$POST" = "0"; trap - EXIT; echo phase2_active_mute_state_diagnostic_complete=true
